sourceText:
mama's broccoli salad ♥
By: uropean cutie
Published: Friday, August 9, 2013 - 12:14pm

Ingredients




Ingredients ♥
4 1/2 cups fresh broccoli florets, chopped into bite-sized pieces
1 cup shredded cheddar cheese
6-8 turkey bacon strips, cooked and crumbled
1/2 cup raisins
1/2 - 1 tsp. minced red onion {to taste}
1/2 cup light  mayonnaise
3 tbs. vinegar
2 tbs. sugar or Splenda

Preparation

1 Directions ♥ 2 1.  In a bowl, combine broccoli, cheese, bacon and raisins. 3 2.  In a separate bowl, whisk together mayonnaise, onion, vinegar and sugar. 4 3.  Pour dressing over broccoli mixture and toss to coat.  Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour.Toss before serving.enjoy! ♥

About

When I was growing up I remember my mama making this delicious broccoli salad, it's the perfect summer salad, I will always remember her in the kitchen sneaking some turkey bacon, then putting some in the salad! It's the perfect picnic salad for parties healthy and delicious! ♥
